title: stardust rollout/chrome-map.json
description: Which nav and footer documents each delivered page uses. Written by deploy/scripts/chrome-map.mjs (deploy Step 6, right after the nav/footer documents) from the documents under content/ and each captured page's locale prefix and <html lang>; read by the sibling encoder. Deterministic: sorted keys, no timestamps, rewritten only when its bytes change. A page in no group uses /nav, /footer and no lang.

groups.description: Keyed by group id: the delivered-path prefix the group's documents were matched on ('/' for the site-wide pair, '/yy/bb' for a locale). Readers treat the id as opaque.

nav.description: DA path of the nav document, e.g. /nav, /nav-yy-bb, /fr/nav (the value of the page's nav metadata row)

footer.description: DA path of the footer document

lang.description: the most common captured <html lang> of the group's pages; null when none was captured

pages.description: delivered URL paths (eds-path deliveredUrl), sorted; readers match them with pathKey

navFile.description: the nav document's file in the code repository (absent when no document exists)

footerFile.description: the footer document's file in the code repository (absent when no document exists)
